name: Pixel Synaptique
description: Extension vivante de l'Omni-Réseau, Pixel Synaptique traite l'information à une vitesse phénoménale. Lié au réseau par des fibres optiques invisibles, il anticipe les mouvements ennemis via la latence zéro.

loadout.armor_outfit: Mass-produced composite tactical exoskeleton with sleek dark plating, integrated neural interface ports, smooth ergonomic lines, and standardized attachment points; worn over a utilitarian bodysuit; heavy black cabling draping from spine; serial numbers etched onto plating
loadout.arsenal: Standard-issue geometric assault rifle with rectangular barrel and integrated neural tether connecting to wrist implants; additional sidearm: compact energy pistol with minimalist design

attitude.behavior: Leaping forward in a full-body combat sprint, weapon raised, while one arm reaches back, fingers splayed, channeling a torrent of dark energy that spirals toward the captor's position; the figure's body is fully committed to the fight, muscles tensing, the moment of capture imminent
attitude.emotion: Dead, hollow stare behind pale skin and glowing blue neural implants; an inexpressive face masked by circuitry, yet radiating a vengeful resolve as dark energy pulses from his being

palette_names.name: Cold Blue Neon
palette_names.role: Neural implants, holographic glitches, accent lighting

palette_names.name: Crimson Dark Energy
palette_names.role: Vengeful energy flow from captured body

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Cinematic rim lighting with cold blue neon highlights; volumetric electric storms creating harsh backlight; localized flashes from shattered holograms; dark energy casting an ominous glow

camera.angle: Low angle looking up with slight dutch tilt to emphasize imposing figure and dynamic tension

scenography.setting: Cyber warfare zone: shattered holographic displays flickering, crumbling digital fortifications, toppling server towers sparking, electric storms rippling through infrastructure
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Glitching holographic shards, cascading code, sparks, rain of electric particles, dark energy vortex connecting subject and captor, electric arcs and micro-explosions
